_comment: app/state_machine.py loads this file rather than hard-coding transitions,
so adding a state is a contract change with a version bump (Part 25.7).
tests/unit/test_state_machine.py proves: every state is reachable from the
initial state, terminal states have no outgoing edges, and no transition
exists that Part 25.6 does not permit.

CREATED.description: Run record exists; nothing has been touched yet.

CHECKING_SOURCE.description: Resolving source files, stability and hashes (Part 12.1 steps 2-5).

WAITING_FOR_FILE.description: A required source is missing or still being written.

OPENING_EXCEL.description: Acquiring a dedicated or attached Excel session (Part 7.1).

WAITING_FOR_USER.description: A person must act, e.g. open a DRM-protected workbook (Part 22.5). Checkpoint preserved.

STAGING.description: Writing chunks and checkpoints to raw staging (Part 6 layer 3).

VALIDATING.description: Quality gate. FAIL here never touches trusted history (Part 9).

UPDATING_HISTORY.description: Transactional history update (Part 8.5). Rollback on any failure.

SYNCING_SQL_SERVER.description: Optional central sync. Failure queues, never re-extracts (Part 13.4).

COMPLETE.description: Terminal. Output published atomically; run evidence immutable.

FAILED.description: Terminal. Last approved dashboard and trusted history preserved (Part 12.6).

CANCELLED.description: Terminal. Cancellation honoured only at a safe boundary (Part 25.5).
